notes: DLV-968 owner decision 2026-11-05: what a content release looks like, as a committed file owned by Content and tested on each side's own pull request. Nothing private: names, shapes and version strings only.

This copy is derived from what Domain reads (PublicationBootstrap for the layout, the manifest and publication.json; SnapshotValidator for the account catalog). ReleaseLayoutContractTest builds a minimal release from this file and loads it through those readers.

Keys and fields not named here are ignored by Domain. The Content packager (tools/utilities/release_packaging.py) is stricter at publication time: it refuses a manifest key outside required+optional, a catalog key outside required+optional, a record without exactly the five fields (id, aliases, route, topicIds, contentType) and a pin outside pinPattern. The producer refuses extras; the reader ignores them.
Change order: Content first (its copy and its tests), then this copy and ReleaseLayoutContractTest in the same Domain change.

layout.note: One folder per release under live/<tag>/; the serving release is the complete folder with the highest tag, or the pinned tag. A folder without manifest.json is a copy in progress. The publish step retires the previous live folder into archive/<same tag>/ (never deleted); Domain reads live/ only. releases/ is a retired prefix and is never written.

manifest.note: releaseId equals the folder's tag. archiveSha256 is the digest of publication.tar.gz; publicationSha256 of publication.json; trustedCatalogSha256 of account-catalog.json; contentSha256, when present, of publication.json followed by account-catalog.json. files lists every archive member with its byte size and digest; totalBytes is their sum. The packager always writes contentSha256 and approvalStatus; Domain ignores approvalStatus.

publication.note: Every asset path starts with /content/ and names an archive member whose digest it repeats; the archive holds nothing else besides publication.json and account-catalog.json.

versionList.note: algorithmVersions, rankingVersions and the two optional lists: distinct non-blank strings; a list may be empty

accountCatalog.pinNote: The producer refuses an entry of the two optional lists outside pinPattern (at most 128 characters); Domain accepts up to maxLength.

record.note: id is unique across records; an alias must not name two different records. The producer writes all five fields on every record (aliases may be an empty list).
